question: The average of a set of fifteen numbers is 12. If 7 is added to each of the numbers in the given set, then what will be the new average?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a constant value 'k' is added to every observation in a set, the original average also increases by the same constant 'k'.

Old Average = 12

Constant added to each number = 7

New Average = 12 + 7 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of observations (n) = 15

**Formula Used:**
